result.Method of Attack: Execution of malicious JavaScript code via postinstall hook that exfiltrates sensitive developer data by searching directories, zipping files, and uploading them to a remote FTP server
Impacted Systems: Developer systems, especially those working in the cryptocurrency sector
result.Attack Vector: Malicious package installation triggering postinstall script execution
Indicators of Compromise: index.js, preinstall.js, package.json files with malicious code
